What did New York households on full service pay per kilowatt hour in 2020, on average?

SELECT round(100 * sum(try_cast(revenues AS double)) / sum(try_cast(sales AS double)), 2) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' AND column06 = 'NY'
Which states publish the most attorney general opinions in the collection?
SELECT state, count(*) AS opinions FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE document_type = 'ag_opinion' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many categories of federal award does USAspending distinguish?
Which states employ the most public school teachers?

SELECT statename, round(sum(try_cast(teachers AS double))) AS teachers FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_059 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many annual reports on Form 10-K reached EDGAR in 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS annual_reports FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings WHERE form = '10-K' AND substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2025'
Which states produced the most utility-scale solar power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.SUN-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the federal government owe in 1790?
SELECT try_cast(debt_outstanding_amt AS double) AS debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_outstanding WHERE record_date = '1790-01-01'
Which states have the most power plants on record with the EIA?
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has Veterans Affairs contract spending in Florida changed from 2018 to 2025?

SELECT action_date_fiscal_year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'FL' AND action_date_fiscal_year BETWEEN '2018' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which parts of the Defense Department paid for research behind the most patent applications?
SELECT level_two AS component, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org WHERE level_one = 'Department of Defense' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal contract actions went to companies in Buffalo in fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(recipient_city_name) = 'BUFFALO' AND recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025'
On which kinds of road did the most people die in 2022?
SELECT func_sysname, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the average U.S. residential electricity price change from 2004 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.US-RES.A' AND period IN ('2004', '2024') ORDER BY 1
How many generating technologies does the Annual Technology Baseline cover?
SELECT count(DISTINCT technology_alias) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_atb_atbe
How many patent lawsuits were filed each year from 2011 to 2020?

SELECT substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
For how many currencies does the Treasury publish reporting rates?
SELECT count(DISTINCT country_currency_desc) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange
In which states did doctors receive the most money from drug and device makers in 2024?

SELECT recipient_state, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are based outside the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_country_code <> 'USA'
Which counties have the most facilities with significant violations?

SELECT concat(fac_county, ', ', fac_state) AS county, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_compliance_status = 'Significant Violation' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Maryland or Virginia get more federal contract dollars in fiscal year 2019?

SELECT primary_place_of_performance_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code IN ('MD', 'VA') AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2019' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which federal district courts handled the most civil cases in the Federal Judicial Center's database?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.district_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How sharply did layoffs jump between February and March 2020?
SELECT period, value AS layoffs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000LDL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period IN ('M02', 'M03') ORDER BY period
Where do families wait longest to get into subsidized housing?

SELECT name, states, try_cast(months_waiting AS double) AS months_waiting FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' AND try_cast(total_units AS double) >= 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many materials in the Materials Project are metals?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_metal AS varchar) = 'true'
Which states have the most fully virtual public schools?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_129 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND virtual = 'FULLVIRTUAL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
